task.title: Produce independently redrawn company-block artwork and editable native projects
task.input: Reference PDF organization/product themes, verifiable company-owned facts, the current PackJoyU wordmark, and the user-authorized GPT Dot remote-software production channel
task.output: company-visual-assets; only one or two independently redrawn website company-block illustrations, editable native software projects, Web images/en-ru alt/dimensions, hashes, and truthful production manifest
task.accept: 1) Actually deliver one or two independently redrawn illustrations for website company blocks. Each has a reference-PDF-page/theme to verifiable company-owned facts or a product schematic containing no hard corporate claims mapping. Borrow only organization and product themes. SHA-256 hashes of the original PDF/JPG/GIF/video and current logo file remain unchanged. No YUHAO certifications/capacity/scale or unsupported actual factories, equipment, or certificates appear in artwork. Redrawing the full 25-page catalogue is not required (E-27, E-111). 2) Every illustration must have both an editable native project under docs/brand-content/source/ and a Web image under public/brand/company/. Actually open every project in its corresponding software, select and edit at least one independent graphic or text object, and retain object/layer-panel and reversible-edit evidence; close without overwriting the registered source file. A flattened screenshot alone is not an editable project. Actually decode every Web image and measure its positive integer width and height. Each item in docs/brand-content/company-visuals.json includes source.path/source.sha256, web.path/web.sha256/width/height, nonempty alt.en/alt.ru describing the actual image, and reference-theme/factual-evidence mappings. Recompute SHA-256 for each actual file and require exact string equality with its manifest value; measured dimensions equal manifest values individually (E-111). 3) The manifest records the actual current PackJoyU logo master file path and SHA-256. Hash that file and require exact equality. Artwork uses that same master, not a candidate logo; production records identify the linked/imported master object. The original logo file is unchanged; project and export contain no old branding or candidate logo. Do not wait for the user to revisit candidate images (E-28, E-111). 4) Provide verifiable actual GPT Dot invocation and software-operation records: the corresponding invocation/session identifier, software name/version, project-opening and Web-export records. Referenced files correspond item by item to manifest paths and SHA-256 hashes. Before delivery reopen projects, decode Web images, and recompute all file hashes; deliver company-visual-assets only when every check passes. If Dot is unreachable, a software step is unperformed, or any required illustration/project/Web image/record is absent, this task remains incomplete. An unperformed-status record, plan, or screenshot alone cannot justify completed delivery or landing (E-29, E-111). 5) The completed boundary of this task is the fully verified asset collection and manifest, not a page-completion claim. M1-T5 owns homepage/about consumption and real-browser integration evidence for shared E-111; T9 must not fabricate page evidence. Native projects and private tool records stay outside public and the production image (E-111).
